description:
Finds the land lot for an address, lot/plan, UK postcode, INSPIRE ID or coordinates.
    Returns the lot's MapMyLot id (row_id), lot/plan, area, perimeter, a point inside it, its
    outline as GeoJSON, a link to view it on mapmylot.com, and the data sources. In hosts that
    show apps the lot is also drawn on a map. Each new lot counts toward the account's daily
    MapMyLot lookups. Requires a free MapMyLot account.

query.description: A street address, a lot/plan (QLD and NSW, e.g. 2/RP213261 or Lot 2 DP236756), a UK postcode, 'INSPIRE ID <number>' (England and Wales), or decimal coordinates 'lat, lon'
query.title: Query

name: mml_find_lot

statement.description: Attribution the licence requires to accompany the data
statement.title: Statement

vintage.description: The published date of the data
vintage.title: Vintage

address.description: Street address inside the lot, where known
address.title: Address

boundary.description: The lot's outline as a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon in WGS84 (lon, lat), simplified for display; null when unavailable
boundary.title: Boundary

lookups_left.description: Free accounts: lots left today (shared with mapmylot.com)
lookups_left.title: Lookups Left

lot_plan.description: Lot and plan as a person reads it, where the source has one
lot_plan.title: Lot Plan

matched_text.description: The lot/plan or address the query resolved to
matched_text.title: Matched Text
